# Disability Intersection

> Person-centered disability consulting, functional nutrition, family support, and body image coaching, led by Lara Minges.

Disability Intersection serves organizations, families, and individuals with a warm, rights-based, non-medical approach.

## Services
- [Program Development & Growth Support](https://disabilityintersection.org/program-development): consulting that helps organizations build person-centered, rights-based programs.
- [Functional Nutrition](https://disabilityintersection.org/functional-nutrition): non-medical, food-first support for people with disabilities and chronic illness. Focused on energy and strength, not weight loss.
- [Family Support & Disability Consulting](https://disabilityintersection.org/family-support): guidance for families navigating regional and developmental services.
- [Body Image Coaching](https://disabilityintersection.org/body-image-coaching): body-neutral coaching.

## About
